messages.author: 964993c75887caa8
messages.subject: Fixing variances
parts:
Hi all,

Would you please check whether there is any mistake in the model below
that may justify this message:

Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive
definite; use lavInspect(fit, "cov.lv") to investigate.

?

modelfus3 <- '
# latent variable definitions
#reflective

VIT =~ lossweiw1 + lossappw1
COG =~ failyearw1 + failmonthw1 + faildmonthw1 + faildweekw1
EMO =~ emptyw1 + nohappw1 + nohopew1

AGE =~ 1.0*HI8_w2
CHARL =~ 1.0*charlsonw1

#fix error variance
HI8_w2 ~~ 0.01*28.79527*HI8_w2
charlsonw1 ~~ 0.09*1.133332*charlsonw1

# regressions

depabvdw2 ~ EMO + VIT + COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1
depaivdw2 ~ EMO + VIT + COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1
hosp3y ~ EMO + VIT + COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1

# covariances

slowstandsw1 ~~ EMO + VIT + COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1 +
AGE + CHARL
EMO ~~ VIT + COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1 + AGE + CHARL
VIT ~~ COG + visimpw1 + hearimpw1 + AGE + CHARL
COG ~~ visimpw1 + hearimpw1 + AGE + CHARL
visimpw1 ~~ hearimpw1 + AGE + CHARL
AGE ~~ CHARL
'

fitfus3 <- sem(modelfus3, data=icopetescsemic, std.lv=TRUE,
ordered=c("slowstandsw1","visimpw1","hearimpw1","lossweiw1","lossappw1",

"failyearw1","failmonthw1","faildmonthw1","faildweekw1","nohappw1","emptyw1","nohopew1","hosp3y",
"depabvdw2","depaivdw2"))

messages.author: ac9e1459001ea58d
messages.subject: Re: Fixing variances
parts:
Anything in particular that makes you think it has to do with fixing the variances? When you added those is when the model went boom? Because the way you entered those looks fine to me – you make single-indicator latent variables and then fix the variance of the observed indicator.

By the way, as to the "AGE =~ 1.0*HI8_w2" line and the one that follows, the 1.0 is superfluous, if you have a single indicator its loading will be fixed to 1 anyway.

Best, 
Stijn

to provide a solution.

Best,
